issue.title: Stabilize Vim normal-key containment tests under the full parallel lane
issue.description: PROPOSED BY: phase bead sase-n4.1 of epic sase-n4. During required just check verification, the tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py family failed intermittently under the full parallel lane while passing in isolation; the phase diff touched LLM usage-limit configuration and provider hooks, not ACE input handling. Fresh landing audit after just install ran the entire file in a 175-test focused bundle and it passed, confirming the full-lane/pass-isolation shape but not resolving it. Reproduce with just test-contention and durable full-run records, identify whether Textual timing, shared keymap/global state, or test cleanup owns the failure, and make the exact node family deterministic without weakening containment assertions. The historical broad task sase-ct is a retired umbrella that explicitly requires a new node-specific task for recurrences.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired broad ACE TUI full-parallel/pass-isolation umbrella; its close reason requires this node-specific task and forbids +1/reopen.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction while landing sase-qx remaining bead-work guard. just check escalated (core-identity-changed after rust-install) to the full 14-worker suite: 34775 passed / 13 skipped / 45 ERRORS, all in tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py — AcePageGroup isolation leak 'notifications: expected 1, got 0'. The same file passed in isolation on this tree (45 passed in 58.90s via pytest -p no:randomly). Diff under test was launch_cwd_bead_work.py plus two docs paragraphs; no ACE vim/keymap code. Same full-lane/pass-isolation shape this bead already tracks. PROPOSED BY sase-qx.land remaining-work pass.

Independent reproduction while implementing wait_dependency_status_counts on 2026-08-20. Required just check passed fmt, Ruff, mypy, feature-flag lint, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, patch terminology, Symvision, toobig, SASE validation, and committed-plan validation, then escalated to the full 14-worker scoped suite (rule: core-identity-changed) and failed only tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py: FAILED test_other_main_screen_vim_hosts_contain_normal_space plus ERRORS in test_ctrl_space_action_is_gated_only_while_prompt_is_mounted and test_other_main_screen_vim_hosts_contain_normal_space. The same file passed immediately on the unchanged tree with .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py -vv: 45 passed in 57.59s. Local diff touches ACE Agents WAITING row dependency-count rendering and bead-status warmup, not Vim normal-key containment logic; this matches the existing full-parallel/pass-isolation family tracked here.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by b8559f36f 'fix(ace): stabilize async teardown and interaction waits' (2026-08-21): tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py now waits for bar.active_text_area() to mount (page.wait_for(lambda _state: active_text_area_mounted())) instead of grabbing it immediately, which is the full-lane/pass-in-isolation shape the bead described. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
